fusions.name: Shake Off
fusions.desc: Shakes out a cone of spray that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocks it back 2 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Through Storm
fusions.desc: Lunges from afar for 8 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at its maximum range. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Soaked Through
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Weather Gait
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
